performance.verdict: Paid channels fully dark; only organic GBP signal has now also flatlined.

findings.text: Zero paid spend and zero leads across all 28 days — Meta and Google Ads appear fully paused, producing no CPL baseline to evaluate.
GBP actions dropped to 0 for the last 14 consecutive days (vs 11 actions on 2026-08-25 alone); -100% 7d delta confirms a hard stop, not gradual decay.
GA4 sessions 3-day signal (Sep 6–8: avg 4.0) vs prior 3 days (Sep 3–5: avg 6.3) — a 37% organic traffic drop with no paid support to explain it.
201 GA4 sessions and 0 GA4 conversions over 28 days with zero paid spend; site conversion tracking is unconfirmed and may be broken.

suggestions.text: Investigate and resolve GBP listing issue; 0 actions for 14 days after a peak of 11 on Aug 25 requires immediate audit.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions have been zero for 14 consecutive days (last meaningful activity: 11 actions on 2026-08-25), a confirmed hard stop per the -100% 7-day delta. Check for a suspended listing, missing business info, or a flagged review that triggered a demotion. Success is confirmed when GBP actions return to ≥3/day for 3 consecutive days. Complete audit by 2026-09-12.

suggestions.text: Watch GA4 sessions for 3 more days; if avg stays below 5/day, escalate as organic traffic collapse requiring investigation.
suggestions.monday_update: The 3-day GA4 session average (Sep 6–8) is 4.0 sessions/day, down from 6.3 the prior 3 days — a 37% drop with no paid traffic to offset it. No action yet as this is a probable signal, not confirmed. Re-check on 2026-09-12; if the 3-day average remains below 5 sessions/day, escalate to a site or SEO audit.

suggestions.text: Verify GA4 conversion tracking fires correctly; 0 conversions across 201 sessions and 28 days is likely a pixel/goal configuration failure.
suggestions.monday_update: 201 sessions and 166 users recorded over 28 days with exactly 0 conversions recorded — this is a hypothesis-level flag that conversion events are misconfigured or unfired. Test at least one form submission or contact action manually to confirm the event fires in GA4 in real time. Success is a confirmed conversion event visible in GA4 debug view. Complete by 2026-09-12.
